# Copilot

This repository is instruction files, not an app.

When the task is code, follow `coding/AGENTS.md` and `shared/base.md`.
When the task is talk, follow `conversation/AGENTS.md` and `shared/base.md`.
When the task is lookup, follow `research/AGENTS.md` and `shared/base.md`.
When the task is prose, follow `writing/AGENTS.md` and `shared/base.md`.

Keep patches small, keep sentences long inside each bullet, and do not invent a brand name for these rules.
